shots.title:
Accounts.
Subscriptions.
Built for Unity.
shots.copy:
Unity UI + PHP backend
+ Stripe subscriptions.
shots.caption:
Start with accounts and subscriptions built.
Configure your backend and Stripe.

shots.title:
Playful menus.
Clear choices.
shots.copy:
Malay interface.
Centered actions.
Teal and gold. Storybook art.
shots.caption:
Edit the Malay menus in Unity scenes
and the shared button prefab.

shots.title: Create an account.
shots.copy:
Name, email, phone and password.
Validation stays close to the form.
shots.caption:
Choose Daftar akaun to register.
Kembali takes you back.

shots.title:
Sign in.
Find your player space.
shots.copy:
Profile and subscription actions,
together in one menu.
shots.caption:
Log masuk opens sign-in.
Find account actions in the player menu.
shots.narrativeGoal: Sign in. Find your player space.

shots.title: Know your player.
shots.copy:
Profile details. Email verification.
Refresh from the same panel.
shots.caption:
View your profile and send a
verification email from the same panel.

shots.title:
Subscriptions,
in the same flow.
shots.copy:
Review subscription details.
Open billing from the player menu.
shots.caption:
Langganan saya shows your plan.
Langgan opens the billing handoff.

shots.title:
The payment starts
with your server.
shots.copy:
Unity requests a ticket.
PHP opens the Stripe checkout route.
shots.caption:
Illustrated: a ticket opens checkout.
No live Stripe transaction is shown.
shots.narrativeGoal: The payment starts with your server.

shots.title:
Access follows
confirmed state.
shots.copy:
Stripe sends a signed webhook.
The server updates. Unity refreshes.
shots.caption:
Browser return never proves payment.
The server confirms subscription access.

shots.title: Keep access honest.
shots.copy:
Fresh server state and
paid-through time govern access.
shots.caption:
The UI shows current manager state.
Local preferences never prove payment.

shots.title:
Small details.
Better control.
shots.copy:
Motion preference
Keyboard focus
Device-conflict recovery
shots.caption:
Navigate with keys, reduce motion,
and recover access on another device.

shots.title: Make it yours.
shots.copy:
Edit scenes, prefabs and theme.
Use the included PDF tutorials.
shots.caption:
Change colors, labels and timing
with ordinary Unity editing tools.
